collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A teacher wonders whether distant children interrupt lessons, invent games, and ask questions adults cannot answer.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A teacher wonders whether distant children interrupt lessons, invent games, and ask questions adults cannot answer.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children gleefully reenact a distant lesson, complete with one pupil who refuses to sit still.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The teacher realizes that some children might learn by watching family members rather than attending formal lessons.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Researchers speculate about halls full of pupils and teachers with different specialties; a young apprentice is delighted.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A shy child wonders whether a vast school would feel lonely; the teacher takes the concern seriously.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They agree that curiosity, boredom, friendship, and mischief might cross every sea.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Their imagined children are so unlike one another that the teacher abandons the idea of a single universal childhood.
